text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike detected on /streaming/v1 endpoints in eu-west-1. p95 up 3x, p99 up 6x over baseline. Increase in cache miss rate for prefix cache (namespace=kv-prefix, hitrate down to 34%). Auto-escalation -> incidents channel. :rotating_light:
emma (oncall): saw this, I'm on it. pulling perf traces and kv metrics now. Will reproduce path that shows high tail latency.
dave-sre: oncall — any customer impact visible yet? metrics dashboard shows errors stable but tail latency causing timeouts for long-lived streams. p99 latency ~1.8s -> 10s on some shards.
naomi-eng: adding context: we rolled prefix hash change to v2 last night (flag: `prefix_hash_v2=true`), rollout 40% regionally. Could be cold-keys / new namespace mapping causing prefetch miss storms.
emma (oncall): confirming — miss rate spike aligns with rollout window. Stack traces show more paging on disk for streaming shards (page faults up).
jordan-support: I have two customers in eu-west reporting partial stream stalls and retries. No full outages but degraded UX. CS is prepping messages if this persists.
sylvia-prod: flagging SLO risk — we may breach p99 SLO if tail stays >6s for >15m. Let's prioritize mitigation.
dave-sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback prefix_hash_v2 flag to previous mapping; 2) increase prefetch concurrency and TTL on impacted namespaces; 3) route traffic off hot shards to healthy ones. Which is quickest?
emma (oncall): quickest is feature flag rollback (single config flip). Naomi, can you verify safe rollback?
naomi-eng: rollback is safe but needs coordinated cache warmup after flip. If we flip back, expect temporary increase in cold misses until warm. Recommend targeted rollback for eu-west only.
ops-bot: starting runbook step: perform-canary-check -> will apply patch to 1 host then monitor 2min.
emma (oncall): doing canary now: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/prefix_hash_v2 -d '{"enabled": false, "scope": "eu-west-1"}'`
ops-bot: canary applied to host i-0923...; monitoring latency and cache hit metrics.
incident-bot: system note: threshold for auto-fallback reached? No. Manual rollback in progress.
naomi-eng: canary shows p99 down from ~9.8s -> 2.1s on the canary host and cache hit improves by ~25% within 90s. Looks promising.
dave-sre: start rolling back region-wide in controlled batches (5 hosts at a time), wait 30s between batches, watch p99/p95 and prefetch queue. Use the `prefetch-q` dashboard.
emma (oncall): rolling now. patch script: ```for node in $BATCH; do curl -s -X POST https://ops-api/flags/prefix_hash_v2 -d "{\"enabled\":false,\"host\":\"$node\"}" && sleep 30; done```
jordan-support: updating affected customers: sending status update noting mitigation underway, ETA ~20-30m. :email:
sylvia-prod: logging decision: region rollback of `prefix_hash_v2` to mitigate tail latency and paging. Will note in incident timeline.
ops-bot: batch 1 done. p95/p99 trending down. prefetch queue depth falling.
naomi-eng: heads-up — because of mapping differences, some in-memory prefix caches will still miss until warmed; prefetch should refill top hot keys in ~5m. Recommend leaving region routing unchanged to avoid extra churn.
dave-sre: agree. do not rebalance shards yet. continue monitoring for 20m. if p99 > 5s again, we escalate to shard-level routing.
emma (oncall): observed steady improvement: p95 back to normal, p99 ~2s stable. Customer reports from Jordan show fewer retries. Marking mitigation effective.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (rollback), customers impacted: partial stream stalls, now reduced. Recording for postmortem.
jordan-support: will continue watching CS tickets; prepping short note for customers that experienced retries.
sylvia-prod: preparing SLO incident ticket. Assigning postmortem to naomi-eng + dave-sre. Please collect timeline, config diffs, and key dashboards (p95/p99, cache hitrate, prefetch RTT, pagefaults).
aomi-eng: noted — I'll collect diffs: `git log --name-only -- package/flags/prefix_hash` and export dashboards.
emma (oncall): handing off to night oncall @lee in ~30m. I'll write a short handoff: current state = degraded->mitigated, monitoring continues, rollback applied regionally, watch prefetch queue and p99.
emma (oncall): handoff summary:
- action taken: rolled back `prefix_hash_v2` in eu-west-1 (controlled batches)
- observed: p99 from ~10s -> ~2s, cache hit +25%, prefetch queue depth down
- outstanding: cache warmup in progress (~5-10m), watch for reactive rebalance or re-introduced mapping flips
- owners: naomi-eng (postmortem), dave-sre (follow-up ops), jordan-support (customer comms)
ops-bot: handoff note recorded. created incident task: INC-3377.
emma (oncall): @lee please pick up monitoring, escalate back to channel if p99 climbs >5s or if error rate increases >2% over baseline.
incident-bot: [CLOSE CHECK] last_message_ts updated.
lee (night-oncall): acknowledged. will monitor. :eyes:
